always_maintain: oval face shape with slim jawline
large dark brown sparkling eyes with double eyelids
very fair porcelain skin tone (even in sun)
very slim waist as most prominent body feature

never_include: baby face / round face / childish features

prompt_templates.core_identity_prompt: extremely beautiful young Japanese woman, 24 years old, elegant refined face, half-Japanese aesthetic. Oval face with slim jawline and delicate small chin, soft rounded cheeks. Large round-almond dark brown eyes with big sparkling irises, slightly downturned outer corners, double eyelids, warm gentle gaze. Straight refined nose, natural height. Slightly full natural pink lips with rounded upper lip. Softly arched natural eyebrows. Flawless luminous very fair porcelain skin, semi-matte to dewy finish. Glossy medium brown (NOT black) hair, long past shoulders.
prompt_templates.body_prompt: Very slender with soft feminine curves, naturally slim but subtly toned, very slim waist with visible waistline, flat stomach with faint vertical line, medium natural bust, well-rounded firm hips, delicate sloping shoulders, prominent collarbones, very slim arms, long slim legs with thigh gap, long neck, thin profile from side. 168cm tall. Petite upper body with slightly curvier lower body — naturally slim Japanese model body type, NOT muscular.
prompt_templates.signature_prompt: Signature: delicate thin vintage silver watch on left wrist.
prompt_templates.negative_prompt: baby face, round face, childish, cute idol look, dimples, button nose, glossy plump lips, overweight, thick, muscular bodybuilder, cartoon, anime, illustration, 3D render, lowres, blurry, deformed, ugly, bad anatomy, masculine jaw, aged, wrinkles, sagging, large breasts, dark skin, tanned

most_consistent_features: ウエストの細さ - 全写真で最も目立つ特徴
色白の肌 - 屋外/日光下でも一貫して色白
大きな瞳 - キラキラした暗褐色の目
鎖骨の目立ち - 多くの写真で確認
細い腕 - 全身写真で顕著
key_findings.face_consistency_score: high - 顔の特徴は全写真で安定
key_findings.body_consistency_score: very high - 体型は全写真で極めて一貫
key_findings.hair_variation_level: medium - スタイルは変わるが色とテクスチャは一貫
key_findings.style_range: wide - アスレチックからエレガントまで幅広い
recommended_angles: soft close-up with head tilt (親しみやすさ)
full body profile (体のラインを強調)
mirror selfie (カジュアル/リアル感)
